text: 金十数据10月17日讯，匈牙利经济学家科莫罗茨基·伊什特万日前在出席第15届欧洲新思想论坛时表示，欧中在全球市场上虽存在竞争，但这并不妨碍彼此保持良好关系，双方应在公平竞争中相互学习，加强对话与合作。科莫罗茨基表示，面对复杂多变的国际形势，欧中更应坦诚交换意见，围绕具体问题开展务实商谈。科莫罗茨基认为，欧中在汽车、能源等领域具有较好的合作基础和发展空间。他不久前途经匈牙利南部时，看到当地正在建设的比亚迪汽车工厂，对其印象深刻。他说，受地缘政治局势等因素影响，欧洲能源供应面临挑战。欧中在风能、水能等可再生能源领域具有合作潜力。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: Hungarian economist István Komoróczki said recently while attending the 15th European New Ideas Forum that although Europe and China compete in the global market, this does not prevent them from maintaining good relations, and the two sides should learn from each other in fair competition and strengthen dialogue and cooperation. Komoróczki said that amid the complex and volatile international situation, Europe and China should exchange views more candidly and conduct pragmatic discussions on specific issues. Komoróczki believes that Europe and China have a good foundation for cooperation and room for development in areas such as automobiles and energy. Not long ago, while passing through southern Hungary, he saw the BYD automobile plant under construction there and was deeply impressed. He said that affected by factors such as the geopolitical situation, Europe's energy supply faces challenges. Europe and China have cooperation potential in renewable energy fields such as wind and hydropower.
